papers.title_en: Matrix Profile for Time-Series Anomaly Detection: A Reproducible Open-Source Benchmark on TSB-AD
papers.evidence: 用于多变量异常检测的可解释且可扩展的矩阵轮廓法
papers.tldr: 本研究针对时间序列异常检测，提出了基于矩阵轮廓（Matrix Profile）的开源基准系统 MMPAD。该系统通过预排序多维聚合、感知排除区的 kNN 检索以及移动平均后处理，解决了传统 MP 方法在复杂场景下的性能瓶颈。在 TSB-AD 基准测试（涵盖单变量和多变量数据）中，MMPAD 展示了其可解释性、可扩展性及竞争力的性能，为该领域的后续研究提供了可复现的参考实现。
papers.abstract_en: Matrix Profile (MP) methods are an interpretable and scalable family of distance-based methods for time-series anomaly detection, but strong benchmark performance still depends on design choices beyond a vanilla nearest-neighbor profile. This technical report documents an open-source Matrix Profile for Anomaly Detection (MMPAD) submission to TSB-AD, a benchmark that covers both univariate and multivariate time series. The submitted system combines pre-sorted multidimensional aggregation, efficient exclusion-zone-aware k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) retrieval for repeated anomalies, and moving-average post-processing. To serve as a reproducible reference for MP-based anomaly detection on TSB-AD, we detail the released implementation, the hyperparameter settings for the univariate and multivariate tracks, and the corresponding benchmark results. We further analyze how the system performs on the aggregate leaderboard and across specific dataset characteristics.The open-source implementation is available at https://github.com/mcyeh/mmpad_tsb.

papers.title_en: On options-driven realized volatility forecasting: Information gains via rough volatility model
papers.authors: Zheqi Fan, Meng, Wang, Yifan Ye
papers.evidence: 利用粗糙波动率模型和深度学习预测已实现波动率
papers.tldr: 本研究探讨了利用期权数据提取的现货波动率能否提升HAR模型对已实现波动率的预测效果。研究采用粗糙随机波动率模型（Rough Heston），通过两步迭代法并结合深度学习代理模型加速大规模期权数据的参数估计。结果表明，融合了粗糙波动率信息的HAR-RV-RHeston模型在日度及长达一个月的预测周期内，表现均优于VIX及Heston、Bates等传统随机波动率模型。
papers.abstract_en: We examine whether model-based spot volatility estimators extracted from traded options data enhance the predictive power of the Heterogeneous Autoregressive (HAR) model for realized volatility. Specifically, we infer spot volatility under the rough stochastic volatility model via an iterative two-step approach following Andersen et al. (2015a) and adopt a deep learning surrogate to accelerate model estimation from large-scale options panels. Benchmarked against traditional stochastic volatility models (Heston, Bates, SVCJ) and the VIX index, our results demonstrate that the augmented HAR-RV-RHeston model improves daily realized volatility forecasting accuracy and sustains superior performance across horizons up to one month.

papers.title_en: Accelerated kriging interpolation for real-time grid frequency forecasting
papers.authors: Carlos Moreno-Blazquez, Filiberto Fele, Teodoro Alamo
papers.evidence: 使用克里金插值的实时电网频率预测
papers.tldr: 针对可再生能源接入带来的电网稳定性挑战，本文提出一种基于克里金插值的加速非参数预测算法。该方法通过优化数值结构显著提升了计算效率，实现了亚秒级的实时频率预测。在配电网仿真验证中，该算法能够直接利用测量数据提供高精度预测，为电网的实时控制和稳定运行提供了高效的数据驱动解决方案。
papers.abstract_en: The integration of renewable energy sources and distributed generation in the power system calls for fast and reliable predictions of grid dynamics to achieve efficient control and ensure stability. In this work, we present a novel nonparametric data-driven prediction algorithm based on kriging interpolation, which exploits the problem's numerical structure to achieve the required computational efficiency for fast real-time forecasting. Our results enable accurate frequency prediction directly from measurements, achieving sub-second computation times. We validate our findings on a simulated distribution grid case study.

papers.title_en: Time-Warping Recurrent Neural Networks for Transfer Learning
papers.evidence: 用于预测燃料含水量的时变循环神经网络
papers.tldr: 本研究针对物理系统在不同环境下演化速度不同的特性，提出了一种基于时间扭曲（Time-Warping）的循环神经网络迁移学习方法。作者证明了LSTM能精确模拟时间滞后模型，并可通过时间扭曲在保持精度的同时适应不同时间尺度。在森林火灾燃料含水率预测任务中，该方法将预训练模型成功迁移至多种时间尺度，仅需修改极少量参数即可达到与传统方法相当的精度。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamical systems describe how a physical system evolves over time. Physical processes can evolve faster or slower in different environmental conditions. We use time-warping as rescaling the time in a model of a physical system. This thesis proposes a new method of transfer learning for Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) based on time-warping. We prove that for a class of linear, first-order differential equations known as time lag models, an LSTM can approximate these systems with any desired accuracy, and the model can be time-warped while maintaining the approximation accuracy.   The Time-Warping method of transfer learning is then evaluated in an applied problem on predicting fuel moisture content (FMC), an important concept in wildfire modeling. An RNN with LSTM recurrent layers is pretrained on fuels with a characteristic time scale of 10 hours, where there are large quantities of data available for training. The RNN is then modified with transfer learning to generate predictions for fuels with characteristic time scales of 1 hour, 100 hours, and 1000 hours. The Time-Warping method is evaluated against several known methods of transfer learning. The Time-Warping method produces predictions with an accuracy level comparable to the established methods, despite modifying only a small fraction of the parameters that the other methods modify.

papers.title_en: ROMAN: A Multiscale Routing Operator for Convolutional Time Series Models
papers.evidence: 用于卷积时间序列模型的多尺度路由算子
papers.tldr: ROMAN是一种针对时间序列的确定性算子，通过构建抗混叠多尺度金字塔并将不同尺度的固定长度窗口映射为伪通道，在缩短序列长度的同时保留了粗粒度位置和多尺度信息。该方法为卷积模型提供了显式的多尺度交互和位置感知能力，在处理长序列时能显著提升计算效率。实验证明，ROMAN在依赖时间结构的任务中表现优异，是卷积分类器的一种高效预处理替代方案。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ROMAN (ROuting Multiscale representAtioN), a deterministic operator for time series that maps temporal scale and coarse temporal position into an explicit channel structure while reducing sequence length. ROMAN builds an anti-aliased multiscale pyramid, extracts fixed-length windows from each scale, and stacks them as pseudochannels, yielding a compact representation on which standard convolutional classifiers can operate. In this way, ROMAN provides a simple mechanism to control the inductive bias of downstream models: it can reduce temporal invariance, make temporal pooling implicitly coarse-position-aware, and expose multiscale interactions through channel mixing, while often improving computational efficiency by shortening the processed time axis. We formally analyze the ROMAN operator and then evaluate it in two complementary ways by measuring its impact as a preprocessing step for four representative convolutional classifiers: MiniRocket, MultiRocket, a standard CNN-based classifier, and a fully convolutional network (FCN) classifier. First, we design synthetic time series classification tasks that isolate coarse position awareness, long-range correlation, multiscale interaction, and full positional invariance, showing that ROMAN behaves consistently with its intended mechanism and is most useful when class information depends on temporal structure that standard pooled convolution tends to suppress. Second, we benchmark the same models with and without ROMAN on long-sequence subsets of the UCR and UEA archives, showing that ROMAN provides a practically useful alternative representation whose effect on accuracy is task-dependent, but whose effect on efficiency is often favorable. Code is available at https://github.com/gon-uri/ROMAN

papers.title_en: New Robust Streaming DMD with Forecasting
papers.evidence: 基于数据快照预测的动态模式分解
papers.tldr: 动态模式分解（DMD）是分析高维动力系统的关键工具。针对大规模数据流处理需求，本文改进了现有的流式DMD算法，通过引入残差界限和精确DMD向量，提升了计算效率并降低了内存占用。该方法在保持低秩近似的同时，显著增强了数值鲁棒性与预测能力，适用于在线应用和高保真数值模拟。
papers.abstract_en: The Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) and the more general Extended DMD (EDMD) are powerful tools for computational analysis of dynamical systems in data-driven scenarios. They are built on the theoretical foundation of the Koopman composition operator and can be considered as numerical methods for data snapshot-based extraction of spectral information of the composition operator associated with the dynamics, spectral analysis of the structure of the dynamics, and for forecasting. In high fidelity numerical simulations, the state space is high dimensional and efficient numerical methods leverage the fact that the actual dynamics evolves on manifolds of much smaller dimension. This motivates computing low rank approximations in a streaming fashion and the DMD matrix is adaptively updated with newly received data. In this way, large number of high dimensional snapshots can be processed very efficiently. Low dimensional representation also requires fast updating for online applications. This paper revisits the pioneering works of Hemati, Williams and Rowley (Physics of Fluids, 2014), and Zhang, Rowley, Deem and Cattafesta (SIAM Journal on Applied Dynamical Systems, 2019) on the streaming DMD and proposes improvements in functionality (using residual bounds, Exact DMD vectors), computational efficiency (more efficient algorithm with smaller memory footprint) and numerical robustness (smaller condition numbers and better forecasting skill).
